description: This file defines the Menu controller class within the Opencart admin tool namespace. It manages the display, creation, editing, and deletion of menu items in the admin interface, including rendering views and handling requests for menu data.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Controller class for managing admin menus in Opencart, providing methods for CRUD operations and rendering views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the menu management page, setting up data and loading views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of menus by delegating to getList controller.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves menu data, builds hierarchical menu structure, and outputs view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a menu, pre-populating fields if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding/editing) a menu item, including permissions, validation, and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected menu items, with permission checks and JSON response.
